name: Selection card
summary: Large clickable option with a title and an explanation. The whole card is the label of a native radio or checkbox.
use: Choices that need an explanation, like a payment method or a plan.
2 to 4 options the user must compare.
avoid: Short options without an explanation: use Radio or Checkbox.
More than 5 options: it takes too much space.
anatomy: Radio or checkbox at the top right.
figmaProps: Price or logo on the right, for example for delivery options.
reactProps: Required. Becomes the label of the input.
Price ("Free", "€ 2.95") or logo on the right. It is part of the label, so it is read out.
Fieldset with a legend. Always 1 column on mobile.
behaviour: Clicking anywhere on the card selects it. Chosen: brand background and a thicker border.
a11y: Native input inside a <label>. Title as the name, explanation as the description.
Always put the group in SelectionCardGroup (fieldset + legend).
Focus ring around the whole card.
content: Title: the choice in one to three words. Explanation: what happens when you choose it.
do: Keep the explanations about the same length, so the cards have the same height.
dont: Links or buttons inside a card: they catch the click.
